camel_example: aliyun sas GetSwitchRegionDetail --region cn-hangzhou --Type sg_switch --Lang en
description_en: Queries the progress of a service switchover. For example, when a server connection is being migrated from China to Singapore, this operation retrieves the migration progress and status
description_zh: 查询服务切换的进度。如：服务器的连接从中国迁移到新加坡的过程中，获取迁移进度、状态等信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas get-switch-region-detail --lang en --type sg_switch --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSwitchRegionDetail

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The service switchover type. Valid values:

sg_switch: The server connection is migrated from China to Singapore.
sls_meta_version_switch_stage_1: The log analysis delivery field upgrade switchover
parameters.help_zh:
服务切换类型。取值：

sg_switch：服务器的连接从中国迁移到新加坡。
sls_meta_version_switch_stage_1：日志分析投递字段升级切换
parameters.name: type

GmtIsAgreeModified.description_en: The time when the authorization operation was modified

IsAgree.description_en: Indicates whether the migration is agreed to

IsNoticed.description_en: Indicates whether the notification has been sent

NeedNotice.description_en:
Indicates whether a pop-up notification needs to be displayed to the user.

true: A pop-up notification needs to be displayed.

false: No pop-up notification needs to be displayed
NeedNotice.description_zh:
是否需要向用户展示弹窗

true：是，需要展示弹窗。

false：否，无需展示弹窗

NeedSwitch.description_en:
Indicates whether a switchover to the new console is required.

true: A switchover to the new console is required.

false: The legacy console is still in use
NeedSwitch.description_zh:
是否需要切换为新版控制台

true：是。需要切换为新版控制台。

false：否。仍使用老版控制台

RegionStatus.description_en: The switchover status of the region

RegionId.description_en: The region where the server resides

Status.description_en:
The migration status. Valid values:
0: waiting for migration
1: switchover succeeded
Status.description_zh:
迁移的状态。取值：
0：等待迁移
1：切换成功

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The China Chinese mainland generates a unique identifier for each request, which can be used for troubleshooting and diagnostics
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
